summary: Iteration 11 backend regression for mobile telemetry instrumentation. Backend (routes/telemetry.py, services/telemetry_service.py) is unchanged from iteration 10. Re-ran iteration 10 suite (29/29 pass) and added iteration 11 mobile-event-shape test suite (7/7 pass). All telemetry, auth-enforcement, sessions, anomaly (ObjectId fix still intact), customers, vehicles, and OCR endpoints function correctly. Total: 36/36 pytest tests pass.

minor.issue: Mobile telemetry helper (mobile/src/lib/telemetry.ts) sends timing under `properties.duration_ms`, but backend's `get_summary()` latency aggregation (`latency_by_action`) only buckets `properties.latency_ms`. As a result, the new mobile timing data does NOT appear in the latency_by_action breakdown. Recommend either (a) renaming mobile field to `latency_ms`, or (b) updating the aggregator to also match `duration_ms`. The events themselves are persisted correctly — only the per-action average latency view is affected.

action_items: (Minor) Reconcile mobile telemetry property naming with backend aggregator: rename `properties.duration_ms` -> `properties.latency_ms` in mobile/src/lib/telemetry.ts (track + startTimer), OR extend backend services/telemetry_service.py:get_summary() $match to also accept `properties.duration_ms`. Otherwise per-action latency dashboards will show empty for mobile events.
(Optional, carried over from iter10) POST /api/customers legacy endpoint silently substitutes 'License'/'Scan' for missing camelCase fields — consider 400 on missing required fields.
critical_code_review_comments: Mismatch between mobile telemetry property name (`duration_ms`) and backend aggregator field (`latency_ms`) — mobile timing data will not appear in latency_by_action view. Easy fix on either side.
/api/telemetry/track and all /api/telemetry/* GET endpoints correctly require Bearer auth (verified parametrically — 12 protected endpoints all return 401 without token).
TelemetryService PostHog graceful degradation verified: `posthog_enabled=false` returned in summary when POSTHOG_API_KEY is unset; no errors logged.
Anomaly _store_anomaly() ObjectId-leak fix from iteration 10 still holds — POST /api/anomalies/scan returns 200 with JSON-serializable body.
routes/telemetry.py is thin and clean — all logic delegated to TelemetryService. No file-size or DRY concerns.
seed_data_creation: Iteration 11 test inserts ~11 telemetry events tagged with a per-run uuid8 session_id (sess-auth-<id>, sess-vin-<id>, sess-dl-<id>, sess-ptt-<id>, sess-cust-<id>). Events have a 90-day TTL on `expires_at` so they self-clean. No customer/vehicle data created in this iteration.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend telemetry surface is fully covered by /app/backend/tests/test_iteration10_telemetry_posthog.py (regression) + /app/backend/tests/test_iteration11_mobile_telemetry.py (mobile event shapes). Both pass against the public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Note the duration_ms vs latency_ms naming gap if main agent decides to surface mobile latency in the dashboard. Auth fixture uses PIN 11111 with setup-pin fallback. All anomaly endpoints under /api/anomalies/* (plural).
rca of the issue: No production bug found in this iteration. The only finding is a minor field-name mismatch (duration_ms vs latency_ms) between the new mobile telemetry helper and the backend latency aggregation pipeline — this does not break event tracking, only suppresses the per-action latency averages for mobile-emitted events.
